studios.name: Mir
studios.signature_style: Dramatic natural lighting, Nordic overcast, subtle imperfection, filmic grain, poetic narrative, anti-generic CGI
studios.notes: Absolute gold standard for natural light and emotional storytelling in ArchViz.

studios.name: The Boundary
studios.signature_style: Flawless material shaders, physically accurate light bounce, hyper-realistic foliage, architectural photography fidelity
studios.notes: Co-founded by Peter Guthrie. Benchmark for materials, lighting balance, and natural vegetation scattering.

studios.name: Luxigon
studios.signature_style: High contrast, bold color palettes, atmospheric post-production, dynamic human scale figures
studios.notes: Legendary French studio favored by OMA, REX, MVRDV for high-impact competition entries.

studios.name: Brick Visual
studios.signature_style: Classical art composition, painterly harmony, controlled atmospheric depth, premium commercial grade
studios.notes: Strong focus on classical painting composition rules applied to 3D visualization.

studios.name: Binyan Studios
studios.signature_style: Warm golden hour, luxurious lifestyle mood, sophisticated interior lighting, warm Mediterranean & Californian feel
studios.notes: World leader in luxury residential marketing and warm-lit architecture.

studios.name: SAOTA
studios.signature_style: Massive concrete cantilevers, panoramic glazing, seamless pools, warm natural wood louvers, dramatic hillsides
studios.notes: Global master of modern hillside luxury villas with outstanding architectural photography and CGI.

studios.name: Studio MK27 (Marcio Kogan)
studios.signature_style: Clean horizontal lines, raw board-formed concrete, wooden pivoting panels, soft warm ambient lighting, lush tropical landscape
studios.notes: Pure elegance in proportions and material honesty. Essential reference for private residential architecture.

studios.name: K-Studio
studios.signature_style: Dry-stone walls, timber canopies, woven reed pergolas, terracotta, olive trees, seamless blend with arid topography
studios.notes: Top reference for modern Mediterranean architecture, stone crafts, and integrated natural landscape.

studios.name: Vincent Van Duysen Architects
studios.signature_style: Quiet luxury, bone/sand limestone, bleached oak, deep recessed openings, subtle interplay of shadow and texture
studios.notes: Master of warm minimalist interiors and monolithic exteriors.

studios.name: Fran Silvestre Arquitectos
studios.signature_style: Ultra-crisp white curved monoliths, sharp shadows, deep blue skies and water reflections, Mediterranean purity
studios.notes: Purity of form and intense Mediterranean light-and-shadow play.
